central-america-caribbean.title: Amerik Santral ak Karayib
central-america-caribbean.description: Amerik Santral ak Karayib la — Yukatan, Beliz, Gwatemala, Ondiras, Salvadò, Nikaragwa, Kosta Rika, Panama, Kiba, Jamayik, Ispayola, Zile Kayiman, Pòtoriko, Ti Zantiy yo ak sid Bahamas.

hispaniola.description: Zile Ispayola nan Karayib la — Ayiti ak Repiblik Dominikèn.
